# KLARA Public API documentation

This repository is a mirror. It carries the documentation of the KLARA API in
Markdown so that documentation aggregators and coding assistants can index it.
It exists because the build repository is private while the documentation is not.

**Do not edit anything here.** Every file is generated by the release pipeline of
the documentation and overwritten on the next run. Corrections belong in the
source.

- Canonical documentation: https://developer.klara.ch/
- OpenAPI specification: https://developer.klara.ch/klara-openapi.json
- Index of all files: https://developer.klara.ch/llms.txt
- Built at: 31 August 2026

## What is in here

- `llms.txt` — index in Markdown, lists every file below
- `md/*.md` — one file per chapter of the documentation
- `md/reference-*.md` — the endpoints of one area each, with parameters, request
  and response bodies, the required permission and the roles that carry it
- `klara-openapi.json` — the contract itself, 97 operations

Where a Markdown file and the specification disagree, the specification is the
contract.
